verdict.rationale: Capacities is object-type-first: users define custom object types with core properties (docs-26, docs-29), prefill them via templates (docs-9), and AI can auto-fill them (docs-4). Date properties surface objects in daily-note references (docs-8), properties export as front matter (docs-31), and a community user praises its tags (comm-2). missing for 10: first-party documentation of property data types and of tagging, explicit docs on filtering or querying by property/tag (smart queries appear only as a pricing bullet), and independent hands-on corroboration of property-based retrieval.
